wiki.title: Royce Duplessis
wiki.extract: Royce Duplessis (born September 14, 1982) is an American attorney and politician serving as a member of the Louisiana State Senate for the 5th district. He assumed office on December 6, 2022. On November 8, 2022, Duplessis defeated Mandie Landry in a special election to fill the vacant 5th district seat.
